Read a diff

Source: R/diff.R
diff_edits.Rd

diff_edits() lists the runs of an edit script. diff_identical() says whether the two inputs were equal.

Usage

diff_edits(d)

diff_identical(d)

Arguments

d

A zudiff object, from diff_vec().

Value

diff_edits(): a data frame with columns op, old_start, old_len, new_start and new_len. diff_identical(): TRUE or FALSE.

Details

Each run is kept ("equal"), deleted or inserted. Ranges are a 1-based start and a length, so x[seq.int(start, length.out = len)] selects a run's elements. A delete has new_len 0 and an insert old_len 0; their empty side's start is the position the run sits before. Adjacent runs never share an operation, and a delete comes before an adjacent insert.

Examples

d <- diff_vec(1:5, c(1:2, 9L, 4:5))
diff_edits(d)
#>       op old_start old_len new_start new_len
#> 1  equal         1       2         1       2
#> 2 delete         3       1         3       0
#> 3 insert         4       0         3       1
#> 4  equal         4       2         4       2
diff_identical(d)
#> [1] FALSE
